name: Exomad Green biochar plants, Concepcion and Guarayos, Bolivia
description: world's largest biochar producer: more than 108,000 t/yr of biochar across two facilities, sequestering about 260,000-420,000 t CO2/yr (company figures vary by date); Microsoft agreement (May 2025) for 1.24 Mt CO2 removal over 10 years - the largest biochar deal to date; world's largest biochar facility under construction in Guarayos since Jun 2025

sources.note: Exomad Green site (world's largest producer; CDR page 108,000+ t biochar, 260,000+ t CO2); carbonherald 21 May 2025 (Microsoft 1.24 Mt deal); read 2026-10-28
